name: Tool Request Guard
description: Normalizes common malformed tool arguments before execution. The initial rule-set repairs web_search language parameters to avoid provider validation failures.

dropInvalidSearchLang.description: Remove unsupported search_lang values instead of sending them upstream.

dropInvalidUiLang.description: Remove unsupported ui_lang values instead of sending them upstream.

searchLangAliases.description: Alias map applied before validating search_lang.

uiLangAliases.description: Alias map applied before validating ui_lang.

enabled.description: When true, block feishu-* sessions from using exec to call openclaw message send directly.

blockMessage.description: Error message returned when a blocked exec openclaw message send command is detected.
